statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient has a history of sick sinus syndrome (I49.5)
The service was to capture the frequency and duration of arrhythmic events
The service was to evaluate for significant bradycardia or pauses during symptomatic periods
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
